response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and a diverse technical background, but his experience lacks depth in the core C++ and industrial automation domains required for this role. His open-source contributions and leadership in developer tooling are impressive, but the role's emphasis on C++, secure engineering, and industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) is not prominently reflected in his resume.
strengths: Extensive experience with event-driven architectures, messaging systems, and modular design (e.g., GISCollective platform).
Proven leadership in developer tooling, open-source projects, and mentoring (e.g., workshops, Fluent-Asserts, Trial).
Diverse technical background with exposure to low-latency systems, multi-threading, and real-time data processing (e.g., Sociomantic, National Instruments).
concerns: Limited recent hands-on experience with C++ (last notable C++ role was in 2014–2015 at National Instruments).
No explicit mention of Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) or industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) in his work history.
Primary expertise lies in web/mobile development (TypeScript, Node.js, React) and scripting, which are not core to this role.
